Test the runtime on your device.

Run deterministic scenes through native Graphite, WebGL and Skia raster, compare pixels, and inspect actual native PDF raster decisions. Results stay in this browser. Software adapters are identified separately from hardware.

Pixel and lifecycle checks

Four deterministic scenes and repeated rendering on each backend. Timing includes CPU work and queue completion; it is not a GPU timestamp measurement.

Document observability

A vector-only PDF must produce no raster-decision events. A blurred page must produce native events with page, bounds and coordinate-space information.

Evidence

The report records adapter identity, pixel errors, native diagnostics, runtime version and workload sizes.

These checks qualify the fixed workload shown here. They do not prove complete overload parity, every font or animation input, indefinite production stability, or compliance with every document standard.
